content.comment_body: I have a pressure sensor with 2 wires for 4-20mA output and a [product_name] [product_name] module. I'm unsure if I wired it correctly, as I'm not getting any pressure readings. Could you please provide instructions on how to wire it to the controller and share a suitable block diagram or programming example? I appreciate your assistance. Thanks and best regards, [user_name].

Are you actually attempting to connect a sensor to an [product_name] module? That module is designed for analog output, not input. For details on connecting your sensor, please review this thread: [url]

Dear [user_name], Could you send an illustration or wiring diagram for connecting a 4-20mA sensor to an [product_name]? Also, could you share a program example that works with it? I am very grateful for your support. Best regards, [user_name].

The wiring diagram is available in the zip file found at the link I shared earlier: [document]. Again, it's not possible to connect the sensor to an [product_name] analog output module. You need an analog input module instead. Program examples can be found on the [company_name] support site: [url]. Be sure to check out the example for correctly scaling a 4-20mA sensor.

Dear [user_name], Thank you for pointing me in the right direction. I will purchase the required analog input module and test it in our plant tomorrow. I appreciate your time. Best regards, [user_name].
You're welcome. Try using the correct module and test it with the example from the provided link. Let me know if this solves your issue or if you need further help.
Dear [user_name], I've tested it and everything works well. Thank you for your assistance. I wish I could thank you in person. Best regards and have a great day, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered an issue by attempting to connect a 4-20mA pressure sensor to the wrong [product_name] expansion module, which was intended for analog output, causing a failure to read sensor data. Guidance and documentation references helped them understand that an analog input module was needed. This case highlights the importance of clearer product identification and wiring instructions for users unfamiliar with specific module roles.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expected the [company_name] module to be compatible with 4-20mA sensor inputs and to have accessible wiring diagrams and relevant programming examples to facilitate easy sensor setup.
